smokeSubset.description: Runs already-covered Activity-owned UI layout and WorkManager one-shot scheduling/cancel paths without enabling Java, Rhino, overlay, screenshot, OCR, or accessibility authority.

examples.title: $autojs.java allowlist call
examples.packagedBehavior: stable packaged allowlist; metadata cannot expand classes or members
examples.skipReason: stable provider still rejects classes, members, handles, or calls outside the reviewed allowlist

examples.title: rhino.install Java proxy globals
examples.packagedBehavior: stable explicit proxy install; no default global mutation
examples.skipReason: rhino.install({ explicit: true }) depends on the Java proxy provider

examples.title: Activity-owned JSON UI layout
examples.packagedBehavior: packaged UI remains gated by lifecycle and disclosure evidence
examples.skipReason: live UI provider may be unavailable for the current execution mode

examples.title: floaty-style overlay migration
examples.packagedBehavior: requires reviewed disclosure, overlay permission, and foreground notification ownership
examples.skipReason: overlay permission or promoted overlay provider may be unavailable

examples.title: WorkManager one-shot task migration
examples.packagedBehavior: one-shot metadata is supported; daily/weekly/intent rows remain gated
examples.skipReason: WorkManager provider or persistent task database substrate may be unavailable

examples.title: Notifications settings and power status migration
examples.packagedBehavior: settings/status metadata is supported; notification ownership, foreground disclosure, and OEM power behavior remain gated
examples.skipReason: notifications/settings or device.power provider may be unavailable

examples.title: Media, mediainfo, and recorder migration
examples.packagedBehavior: read-only media status and recorder denial are covered; real recording requires privacy-reviewed foreground disclosure
examples.skipReason: media, mediainfo, recorder, or scoped media fixture may be unavailable

examples.title: screenshot plus OCR migration
examples.packagedBehavior: packaged capture/OCR requires disclosure manifest and permission review
examples.skipReason: MediaProjection permission, image handle, or OCR provider may be unavailable
